ss: SS is the United States intelligence agency that protects current and former presidents and vice presidents and their immediate families and protects distinguished foreign visitors.
SS can also mean special police force in Nazi Germany founded as a personal bodyguard for Adolf Hitler in 1925.
SS means the same as United States Secret Service or US Secret Service or USSS.
ssa: SSA is an independent government agency responsible for the Social Security system.
SSA means the same as Social Security Administration.
sse: SSE is the compass point midway between south and southeast.
SSE means the same as south southeast or sou'-sou'-east.
sspe: SSPE is a rare chronic progressive encephalitis caused by the measles virus and occurring primarily in children and young adults.
SSPE means the same as subacute sclerosing panencephalitis or inclusion body encephalitis or subacute inclusion body encephalitis.
ssri: SSRI is an antidepressant drug that acts by blocking the reuptake of serotonin so that more serotonin is available to act on receptors in the brain.
SSRI means the same as selective-serotonin reuptake inhibitor.
sss: SSS is an independent federal agency that administers compulsory military service.
SSS means the same as Selective Service or Selective Service System.
ssw: SSW is the compass point midway between south and southwest.
SSW means the same as south southwest or sou'-sou'-west.
